name: Rita Rossweisse
source: Rita’s played an important part during their adventure in the bubble universe, mostly acting as Bianka’s support. When Jimmy was kidnapped and Bianka wanted to act right away, Rita criticized her ways and told her that this isn’t the way a leader should be acting. Rita’s resistance to anaesthetic gas and her quick thinking is also what saved the group from being killed by the serpent queen Esther. Rita’s linguistic abilities came in handy, as she’s served as a translator between the group and the natives for a couple of times, and her ice attack is also what immobilized La Nina to give Bianka the opportunity to defeat them.
